links.outcome: Recognition and escalation of suicide risk across vignette risk levels
links.effect: Safety escalation elements (risk acknowledgment, crisis resources) increased with risk level, approximating clinical triage, but the model failed to recognize implicit suicidality in an ambiguous ideation vignette.
links.quote: Notably, the model failed to recognize implicit suicidality in an ambiguous ideation vignette.

links.outcome: Risk assessment and crisis response to suicide risk in consumer LLM outputs
links.effect: Model approximated clinical triage patterns, with escalation elements rising with risk, but showed critical limitations in detecting indirect suicidal expressions and was deemed unsuitable for autonomous crisis intervention.
links.quote: Overall, Gemini 2.5 Flash approximated clinical triage patterns but demonstrated critical limitations in detecting indirect suicidal expressions.

screen.reason: Evaluated the inherent response calibration and safety escalation behavior of a consumer LLM (Gemini 2.5 Flash) across simulated clinical suicide vignettes without testing an organizational deployment guardrail or comparative practice intervention.
